findings.what: Connect Towns: the line that gets the x2 is now fixed when the contract completes; it no longer moves to the last direct line boarded (deliver_passengers.script.tl handleEvent returns before acceptance and after completion). Lines 51 and 82 of subsidies.md to rewrite.

Connect Towns offer: every direct line between the two towns is checked for a passenger vehicle, not only the first one found (subvention_util.getLinesConnectingTowns). subsidies.md:53 stays true, more strictly.

Card texts: "2x Income for {duration} on First Established Connection" (Connect Towns) and "... on All Supplying Lines" (cargo contracts) replace "2x Income for {duration}": quote the new labels (gamestrings.py).
The automatic line configuration now clears a stop's alternative terminals (line_util.tl, next to the Max. Additional Wait default). Check in game; also for the dashboard's line_set_terminals.
101 of 727 references moved or changed between 40425 and 40444: run scan.py --diff 40425 <stable> --renumber when it reaches stable.
